SQL:
WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.order_date" AS "order_date",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _stage_inner
), base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', monthly_rev.order_date) AS "monthly_rev.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(monthly_rev.rev) AS DOUBLE) AS "monthly_rev.revenue"
  FROM monthly_rev AS monthly_rev
  WHERE
    (
      monthly_rev.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND monthly_rev.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', monthly_rev.order_date)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "monthly_rev.order_date",
    "monthly_rev.revenue",
    SUM("monthly_rev.revenue") OVER (ORDER BY "monthly_rev.order_date") AS "monthly_rev.running_total"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  "monthly_rev.order_date",
  "monthly_rev.revenue",
  "monthly_rev.running_total"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "monthly_rev.order_date",
    "monthly_rev.revenue",
    "monthly_rev.running_total"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "monthly_rev.order_date" ASC
LIMIT 21
